tools.name: gateway.auth_connect
tools.description: Store credentials for a server and make them available to provisioning. Use this when gateway.provision reports missing authentication.

credential.description: API key, token, or subscription credential to store

auth_mode.description: API-key storage or URL-mode elicitation acknowledgement

consent_acknowledged.description: Acknowledge that the out-of-band URL flow was completed

tools.name: gateway.cancel
tools.description: Cancel a pending tool invocation. By default, refuses to cancel healthy requests (recent heartbeat). Use force=true to cancel anyway. Use gateway.list_pending first to see request IDs and health status.

request_id.description: Request ID in format "server_name::local_id" from gateway.list_pending

force.description: Force cancel even if request is healthy (has recent heartbeat)

tools.name: gateway.catalog_search
tools.description: Search for available tools across all connected MCP servers. Returns compact capability cards without full schemas. Use filters to narrow results by server, tags, or risk level. Set include_offline=true to also include cached tools of offline servers and, with a query, provisionable manifest servers not yet started. This is the primary tool discovery entry point.

query.description: Search query to match against tool names, descriptions, and tags

filters.description: Narrow results by server, tags, or risk level

server.description: Filter to tools from a specific server

tags.description: Filter to tools with any of these tags

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

include_offline.description: Also include cached tools of offline servers and, with a query, manifest servers never started (manifest_candidates)

tools.name: gateway.config_status
tools.description: Show read-only effective configuration and startup policy status with source attribution and non-secret diagnostics.

tools.name: gateway.connect_server
tools.description: Connect or start a known downstream MCP server by name. Resolves configured, provisioned manifest, and registered discovered servers.

server_name.description: Name of the server to connect

tools.name: gateway.describe
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific tool, including its arguments and constraints. Use this before invoking a tool to understand its requirements.

tools.name: gateway.disconnect_server
tools.description: Disconnect a running downstream MCP server without changing persistent config. Refuses by default when that server has pending requests; set force=true to cancel them.

server_name.description: Name of the server to disconnect

force.description: Cancel this server's pending requests before disconnecting

tools.name: gateway.get_startup_policy
tools.description: Return persisted autoStart and legacy disableAutoStart entries grouped by config source.

tools.name: gateway.health
tools.description: Get the health status of the gateway and all connected MCP servers. Shows server status, tool counts, and last refresh time.

tools.name: gateway.invoke
tools.description: Invoke a tool on a downstream MCP server. Arguments are validated against the tool schema before execution. Output is automatically truncated if too large.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool (must match tool schema)

task.description: Run as an MCP task (long-running invocation)

enabled.description: Run as an MCP task when the server supports it

ttl.description: Requested task TTL in seconds (sent to the downstream server in milliseconds)

poll_interval.description: Seconds between task status polls (sent to the downstream server in milliseconds)

options.description: Timeout, output truncation, and redaction options

max_output_chars.description: Output size budget for this call: output is truncated at 4x this many UTF-8 bytes

redact_secrets.description: Redact detected secrets from output. Without options, task results are redacted and plain results are not

trace_context.description: Trace context forwarded to the downstream server

_meta.description: Request metadata; trace context keys are forwarded downstream

evidence_label_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the caller evidence label

tools.name: gateway.list_pending
tools.description: List all pending tool invocations with health status. Shows elapsed time, heartbeat age, and current state for each request. Use this to monitor long-running operations before deciding to cancel.

server.description: Filter to pending requests on a specific server (optional)

tools.name: gateway.provision
tools.description: Provision (install and start) a specific MCP server from the manifest. Use this after reviewing candidates from gateway.request_capability. Returns immediately with a job_id for tracking. Poll gateway.provision_status to check progress. Use gateway.request_capability instead if you don't know the exact server name.

server_name.description: Name of the server to provision (from manifest)

tools.name: gateway.provision_status
tools.description: Check the status of a running server installation. Use after gateway.provision returns a job_id. Returns progress percentage, output log, and final tools when complete.

tools.name: gateway.refresh
tools.description: Reload backend MCP server configurations and reconnect. Use this when new MCP servers have been configured or to recover from connection errors. Refuses by default while downstream requests are pending; set force=true to cancel them.

force.description: Cancel pending downstream requests before refreshing

tools.name: gateway.register_discovered_server
tools.description: Register an externally-discovered MCP server package so it can be provisioned. Call this after gateway.search_registry to register the chosen package, then call gateway.provision to install and start it. Registration pins the version resolved from npm; gateway.provision refuses it until an operator approves that exact version (pmcp trust approve-package) or package policy allows it.

server_name.description: Logical name for this server (e.g. 'github') used with gateway.provision

description.description: Short description of the server's purpose

tools.name: gateway.request_capability
tools.description: Recommend the right tool for a task — describe what you need in natural language. Examples: 'scrape a website', 'search Slack messages', 'query Postgres', 'browse the web'. Matches against installed CLIs and 90+ provisionable MCP servers and returns ranked candidates; it does NOT start anything — call gateway.provision to actually install/start the recommended server. Prefer this over gateway.provision when you don't already know the exact server name.

query.description: Natural language description of the capability needed (e.g., 'I need to scrape a website', 'browser automation')

available_clis.description: Optional: CLIs known to be available in the environment

tools.name: gateway.restart_server
tools.description: Restart a known downstream MCP server without changing persistent config. Refuses by default when that server has pending requests; set force=true to cancel them.

server_name.description: Name of the server to restart

force.description: Cancel this server's pending requests before restarting

tools.name: gateway.search_registry
tools.description: Search the public MCP Registry for external servers not in the local manifest. Use this when gateway.request_capability returns not_available. Returns package names and metadata; call gateway.register_discovered_server then gateway.provision to install. Provisioning a discovered package needs an operator to approve its exact version first (pmcp trust approve-package) unless package policy allows it.

query.description: Natural language description of the capability needed

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: gateway.set_startup_policy
tools.description: Preview or explicitly apply an autoStart add/remove/set operation against one selected config source or path.

operation.description: Mutation to apply to the autoStart list

names.description: Server names the operation applies to

source.description: Config source to edit (project, user, or custom)

tools.name: gateway.submit_feedback
tools.description: Prepare a PMCP feedback issue for GitHub. Returns an exact preview payload and a browser URL an operator can open. pmcp posts nothing itself unless the operator has enabled submission (`pmcp guidance --feedback-submission on`) and exported PMCP_FEEDBACK_TOKEN; confirm_submission=true records the user's consent and is not by itself authority to post.

confirm_submission.description: Set true only after user confirms submission

tools.name: gateway.sync_environment
tools.description: Sync environment information from the host. Detects the platform (mac/wsl/linux/windows) and probes for installed CLIs. This information is used to prefer CLIs over MCP servers when matching capabilities.

tools.name: gateway.tasks_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a downstream MCP task by opaque task ID. Only a task PMCP has recorded (from gateway.invoke with task, gateway.tasks_list, gateway.tasks_get or gateway.tasks_result) can be cancelled; an already-finished task is reported without a downstream call. Use gateway.cancel only for PMCP request IDs from gateway.list_pending.

force.description: Passed as force in the downstream tasks/cancel request; PMCP applies no health check of its own

tools.name: gateway.tasks_get
tools.description: Get current status for one downstream MCP task.

tools.name: gateway.tasks_list
tools.description: List brokered downstream MCP tasks. MCP task IDs are opaque downstream task identifiers, not PMCP request IDs.

tools.name: gateway.tasks_result
tools.description: Fetch a downstream MCP task result and apply the same output redaction and truncation options as gateway.invoke.

max_output_chars.description: Output size budget for this call: output is truncated at 4x this many UTF-8 bytes

redact_secrets.description: Redact detected secrets from output. Without options, task results are redacted and plain results are not

tools.name: gateway.update_server
tools.description: Update a subordinate MCP server package to latest version and restart it so the new version is actually running. Call this to check for and apply an update -- the gateway does not volunteer update notices, so nothing will prompt you. Refuses a server whose config pins a version, and a server registered with gateway.register_discovered_server. Refuses to restart by default when the server has pending requests; set force=true to cancel them.

force.description: Restart the server even if it has pending requests or active MCP tasks, cancelling them. Mirrors gateway.restart_server's force flag.
